subject: Quick thought on Emergency Dental of Omaha's mobile booking
body: Hi Dr. Roberto Monteagudo and team, I came across Emergency Dental of Omaha while looking into practices providing crucial same-day care in Nebraska. Your dedication to handling urgent toothaches and extractions when patients need it most is fantastic. While browsing your current site, I noticed that the main contact telephone numbers are a bit buried in text-dense areas, and mobile visitors lack a sticky call-to-action bar for immediate pain management booking. To see how these friction points could be solved, I put together a clean, modern prototype for your practice. It features a sticky emergency contact bar, a streamlined bento grid for services like general dentistry and urgent evaluations, and enhanced local geo-intent for Omaha searches. You can check out the live preview here: https://nayom-biz-0x8793f29582007b19-0xc0f9b048bbc342a.vercel.app. If you would like to use this design or have me tweak anything, I would be happy to send over the project files or chat for five minutes. No worries at all if you are happy with your current setup!
key_improvements: Added a sticky 'Call Now / Book Same-Day' action bar for mobile visitors
Highlighted phone numbers and contact actions more prominently
Streamlined service offerings into a clean bento grid layout
Enhanced local geo-intent metadata for Omaha emergency dental searches
